sections.h: 3. Ngā Whāinga me ngā Tūāpapa Ture o te Tukatuka

Ka tukatukahia e te Kaiwhakarato ngā raraunga whaiaro mō ngā whāinga e whai ake nei, ā, i runga i ngā tūāpapa ture e whai ake nei i raro i te Wāhanga 6(1) GDPR:

  • Te Whakatutukitanga ki ngā herenga ture (Wāhanga 6(1)(c)): ngā mahi kaute, tāke me te nama.
  • Ngā painga tika (Wāhanga 6(1)(f)): te tiaki i te Tūāpapa, te ārai i te tinihanga me te tukino, te pupuri i te pūmautanga o te ratonga, te pupuri i ngā inenga ratonga ā-roto e tiaki ana i te tūmataitinga, me te tukatuka i ngā ihirangi pāpāho pāpori e wātea ana ki te iwi whānui mō ngā tātari auaha.

4.2. 4.3. Ka taea e koe te muku i ngā pāpāho i tukuna me ngā rawa i hangaia i roto i te taiwhanga o te Tūāpapa i ngā wā katoa. I te mukunga o tō pūkete, ka tangohia ngā ihirangi e hāngai ana, engari ki te hiahia te ture kia pupuritia (tirohia te Wāhanga 7).

6.1. Ko ngā pātengi raraunga me te waehere tono a te Papamahi kei runga i ngā tūmau kei roto i te Rohe Ōhanga Pākehā (EEA).

6.2. 8.2. Ko te uru ki ngā raraunga whaiaro ka herea ki ngā tāngata e hiahia ana ki te whakahaere i te Papamahi, ā, e herea ana e ngā herenga muna.

8.3. Ki te puta he takahi raraunga whaiaro ka puta he mōrearea ki ō motika me ō herekore, ka whakamōhio te Kaiwhakarato i te mana tirotiro whai mana, ā, ki te hiahiatia e te Tuhinga 34 GDPR, ngā Kaiwhakamahi kua pā.

sections.h: 9. Ō Motika i raro i te GDPR
sections.b:
Kei a koe te motika ki te:

  • tono uru ki ō raraunga whaiaro me te tiki kape o aua raraunga;
  • tono whakatikatika i ngā raraunga hē, kāore rānei i oti;

  • tono whakawhāiti i te tukatuka;
  • tiki i ō raraunga i roto i te whakatakotoranga hanganga, ka taea te pānui e te mīhini, ka tukuna ki tētahi atu kaiwhakahaere (te kawe raraunga);

Hei whakamahi i ēnei motika, tukuna he tono ki SEO@trendtraffic.pro. Ka whakautu te Kaiwhakarato i roto i te marama kotahi (ka taea te whakaroa e rua atu marama mō ngā tono uaua, me te whakamōhio).

sections.h: 10. Te Mātauranga Horiana me te Ture (EU) 2024/1689 (Ture AI a te EU)
sections.b:
10.1. Ka whakauru te Paparanga i ngā tauira AI whānui e wātea ana ki te iwi whānui a ngā kaiwhakarato tuatoru mā roto i ā rātou API mana (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, FAL.ai) mō te tātari auahatanga, te whakaputa tuhinga me ngā kupu matua, te whakamaori, te tātari ataata anga-ki-anga, te whakaputa avatar me te whakahāngai reo. Kāore te Kaiwhakarato e whakawhanake, e whakangungu rānei i ōna ake tauira AI, ā, ehara hoki i te kaiwhakarato tauira AI whānui i roto i te tikanga o te Ture (EU) 2024/1689 (te "Ture AI a te EU").

10.2. Ko ngā whakamahinga AI a te Paparanga ka taka ki roto i ngā kāwai morearea-iti me ngā kāwai morearea-iti o te Ture AI a te EU. Kāore te Paparanga e whakamahi i ngā pūnaha AI morearea-nui i roto i te tikanga o te Āpitihanga III o te Ture.

Ki te whakauru ngā kaiwhakarato AI taketake i ngā tohu ka taea te pānui e te mīhini, i ngā tohu wai rānei ki roto i ngā ihirangi i hangaia (Wāhanga 50(2) o te Ture AI a te EU), ka pupuri te Paparanga i aua tohu, ā, kāore e tangohia. 10.4. Ko ngā mahi e rāhuitia ana e te Wāhanga 5 o te Ture AI a te EU — te raweke huna, te whakamahi i ngā whakaraeraetanga (tae atu ki ērā o ngā tamariki), te whakatau i te tūnga pāpori, te aromatawai matapae i te hara o ngā tāngata takitahi, te waruwaru kore-whāinga o ngā whakaahua kanohi mai i te ipurangi, i te CCTV rānei, te mōhio ki te kare ā-roto i te wāhi mahi me te mātauranga, te whakarōpū koiora i runga i ngā āhuatanga tairongo, me te tautuhi koiora mamao i te wā tūturu i ngā wāhi tūmatanui — kāore e tukuna e te Paparanga, e rāhuitia ana e ngā Tikanga Ratonga, ā, ka whakakorehia ngā tono e whai ana ki aua mahi.

Mena kua tāpirihia he tikanga utu, ā, kāore i whakakorea te ohaurunga i mua i te mutunga o te whakamātautau, ka utua te utu ohaurunga tuatahi ina pau te whakamātautau.

6.2. Ngā Kaihoko i te EU — te whakakore i te tika whakamuri: i runga i te Aratohu 2011/83/EU me te Ture Polish o te 30 o Mei 2014 mō ngā Tika Kaihoko (otirā ko ngā whakaritenga mō te tuku ihirangi matihiko me ngā ratonga matihiko), mā te whakahohe i tētahi ohaurunga utu ka tono me te whakaae te kaihoko kia tīmata tonu te mahi, i mua i te paunga o te wā whakamuri 14-rā paerewa, ā, ka whakaae ia ka ngaro i a ia te tika whakamuri mai i te wā e wātea katoa ana te ratonga. 6.3. 6.4. 7.1. sections.h: 9. Ngā Āhuatanga AI, Ngā Ihirangi Waihanga me te Mārama
sections.b:
9.1. Ko ngā āhuatanga AI o te Papamahi e mahi ana i runga i ngā tauira whānui-kaupapa e wātea ana ki te iwi whānui o ngā kaiwhakarato tuatoru (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, FAL.ai) i karangatia mā ngā API whaimana. Ko ngā taipitopito o te tukatuka raraunga kei roto i te Kaupapahere Tūmataitinga.

9.2. Ko ngā ihirangi i hangaia e AI (ngā tātari, ngā tuhinga, ngā kupu matua, ngā reo-whakaahua, ngā ataata) ka hē, ka kore rānei e tika, ā, ehara i te tohutohu ngaio, ture, hauora, pūtea rānei. Me arotake e te Kaiwhakamahi ngā ihirangi i hangaia i mua i te whakamahi, te whakaputa rānei, ā, māna e kawe te kawenga katoa mō tōna whakamahi.

Te Whakaatu i ngā Ihirangi Waihanga: ki te waihanga, ki te raweke rānei te Kaiwhakamahi i ngā ihirangi whakaahua, oro, ataata rānei e tino rite ana ki ngā tangata, ngā mea, ngā wāhi, ngā kaupapa rānei e noho ana, ā, ka taea te puta heka ki tētahi tangata he tūturu, he pono rānei (he "deep fake"), me whakaatu mārama, wehewehe hoki te Kaiwhakamahi kua hangaia, kua raweketia rānei te ihirangi e te tangata, i runga i te Wāhanga 50(4) o te EU AI Act me ngā ture o ngā whatunga pāpori e whakaputaina ai te ihirangi. Ki te whakauru ngā kaiwhakarato AI tuatoru i ngā tohu ka taea te pānui e te mīhini, i ngā tohu wai rānei ki roto i ngā ihirangi i hangaia, kaua te Kaiwhakamahi e tango, e huna rānei i aua tohu.

9.4. Kāore te Kaiwhakarato e kī taurangi he kore noa ngā ihirangi i hangaia e AI i ngā mana o ngā tuatoru (hei tauira, ki te whai ngā whakaurunga a te Kaiwhakamahi i ngā rauemi tiaki) ā, kāore e kī taurangi i tētahi hua arumoni motuhake (ngā tirohanga, te whānuitanga, te moni whiwhi).

sections.h: 10. Ngā Ihirangi a te Kaiwhakamahi me te Mana Pupuri Hinengaro
sections.b:
10.1. Ka mau tonu te Kaiwhakamahi i ngā mana katoa ki ngā rauemi ka tukuna e ia. Ka mutu te raihana ina mukua te ihirangi, te pūkete rānei, haunga ngā tārua e hiahiatia ana e te ture.

10.2. I waenganui i te Kaiwhakarato me te Kaiwhakamahi, kāore te Kaiwhakarato e kī ana i ētahi mana ki ngā putanga i hangaia mō te Kaiwhakamahi. Ko ngā mana o te Kaiwhakamahi ki ngā putanga i hangaia e AI ka whakatauhia e te ture e hāngai ana me ngā tikanga o ngā kaiwhakarato AI tuatoru e whai wāhi ana; mā te Kaiwhakamahi te kawenga ki te whakamana kua whakaaetia tana whakamahinga i whakaarohia.

10.3. Ko te pūmanawa, te hoahoa, ngā tohu hokohoko me ngā pātengi raraunga o te Papamahi ka noho tonu hei taonga mā te Kaiwhakarato, mā ōna kaiwhakarato raihana rānei. Kāore ēnei Tikanga e whakawhiwhi i ētahi mana ki a rātou i tua atu i te mana ki te whakamahi i te Papamahi kia rite ki te whakaaro.

10.4. Ko ngā ihirangi tuatoru e whakaatuhia ana i roto i ngā tātaritanga au (ngā ataata, ngā uhi, ngā inenga o TikTok/Instagram/YouTube) ka noho tonu hei taonga mā ngā kaipupuri mana me ngā papamahi e hāngai ana; ka whakaatuhia hei tātaritanga mākete. Ko ētahi atu whakamahinga o aua ihirangi e te Kaiwhakamahi (hei tauira, te tuku anō i te ataata a tētahi atu) me whai take ture ake mā te Kaiwhakamahi.

sections.h: 11. Tiaki Raraunga; Te Tukatuka i te Ingoa o te Kaiwhakamahi
sections.b:
11.1. Ko te tukatuka i ngā raraunga whaiaro o ngā Kaiwhakamahi e whakaahuatia ana i roto i te Kaupapahere Tūmataitinga.

11.2. Ki te whai raraunga whaiaro o ngā taha tuatoru ngā rauemi ka tukuna, ka tukatukahia rānei e te Kaiwhakamahi i runga i te Papamahi (hei tauira, te ahua, te reo rānei o tētahi kaiwhakaatu, ngā arotake a ngā kaihoko), ka mahi te Kaiwhakamahi hei Kaiwhakahaere Raraunga mō aua raraunga, ā, ka tukatukahia e te Kaiwhakarato hei Kaiwhakatika i roto i te tikanga o te Wāhanga 28 GDPR — i runga anake i ngā tohutohu kua tuhia a te Kaiwhakamahi e whakaatuhia ana mā te whakamahi i ngā āhuatanga o te Papamahi, ā, hei whakarato anake i te ratonga.

11.3. Ka whakamahia e te Kaiwhakarato ngā tikanga haumarutanga hangarau me te whakahaere e tika ana, ka mahi tahi anake me ngā kaiwhakatika-iti kua rārangihia i roto i te Kaupapahere Tūmataitinga (ka whakaae te Kaiwhakamahi ki tā rātou mahi tahi; ka pānuitia ngā huringa nui), ka āwhina i te Kaiwhakamahi i roto i te take me ngā tono a te tangata raraunga, ā, ka muku, ka whakahoki rānei i ngā raraunga i te mutunga o te ratonga i runga i ngā ture pupuri o te Kaupapahere Tūmataitinga.

sections.h: 12. Whakakāhoretanga o ngā Pūtāhui me te Whakawhāititanga o te Taunahatanga
sections.b:
12.1. "Kia rite ki tōna āhua": ka whakaratohia te Papamahi "kia rite ki tōna āhua" me "kia rite ki te wātea". Ki te whānuitanga e whakaaetia ana e te ture, kāore te Kaiwhakarato e pūtāhui ka mahi te Papamahi me te kore e haukotia, e hapa rānei, ka tutuki rānei i ngā tūmanako motuhake a te Kaiwhakamahi.

12.2. Ngā whakawhirinakitanga tuatoru: ko te mahi a te Papamahi e tino whakawhirinaki ana ki ngā kaiwhakarato tuatoru. Kāore te Kaiwhakarato e taunaha mō: ngā haukotanga, ngā huringa ture, ngā here rānei o ngā API me ngā ratonga o TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube/Google, TikHub, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Google (Gemini, Flow, NotebookLM), Anthropic, OpenAI, FAL.ai, Blotato, Stripe rānei; mō ngā whakatau whakatikatika o ngā whatunga pāpori e pā ana ki ngā ihirangi i whakaputaina e te Kaiwhakamahi; mō ngā take rānei e pā ana ki ngā kaiwhakarato manaaki.

12.3. Ki te whānuitanga e whakaaetia ana e te ture, kāore te Kaiwhakarato e taunaha mō ngā pakaru arataki, ngā hua ngaro, te ngaronga o ngā raraunga, te ngaronga rānei o ngā kaihoko i puta mai i te whakamahi, i te kore rānei e taea te whakamahi, i te Papamahi.

12.4. Ko te taunahatanga katoa o te Kaiwhakarato ki te Kaiwhakamahi mō ngā kerēme katoa ka whakawhāitihia ki te moni i utua e te Kaiwhakamahi mō ngā ratonga o te Papamahi i te marama maramataka whakamutunga i mua i te takahanga i puta ai te kerēme.

12.5. Kāore ngā whakawhāititanga i roto i tēnei Wāhanga e pā ana ki te taunahatanga mō te mahi hē i runga i te whakaaro, i te mangere nui rānei, mō te mate, te wharanga whaiaro rānei, i ētahi atu take rānei e kore e taea te whakawhāiti i te taunahatanga i raro i te ture whakahau. Mō ngā kaihoko, ka mau tonu ngā rongoā ā-ture mō te kore e rite o ngā ratonga matihiko (Wāhanga 6.4).

sections.h: 13. Whakatarewatanga me te Whakamutunga
sections.b:
13.1. Ka taea e te Kaiwhakamahi te whakamutu i te whakamahi i te Papamahi me te muku i te pūkete i ngā wā katoa; ka pā te Wāhanga 6 ki ngā utu kua utua kē.

13.2. Ka taea e te Kaiwhakarato te whakatarewa, te whakamutu rānei i te pūkete, te tango i ngā ihirangi me te kore e whakaae ki te ratonga — me te kore e whakahoki i ngā moni kua utua kē — i te wā o te takahi nui o ēnei Tikanga (ina koa te Wāhanga 8), ina hiahiatia e te ture, e te ota rānei a tētahi mana whai mana, i te wā rānei o tētahi riri haumarutanga nui. Ki te tika, ka tukuna tuatahi e te Kaiwhakarato he whakatūpato me te whakatakoto i tētahi rā mutunga hei whakatika i te takahi; i te take o ngā kaihoko, ka mau tonu ngā mana ā-ture e pā ana ki ngā wā utu ki te kore te whakamutunga e pā ana ki te takahi a te kaihoko.

13.3. Ka mau tonu ngā Wāhanga 6, 10, 12 me 15 i muri i te whakamutunga.

sections.b:
14.1. Ka taea e te Kaiwhakarato te whakarerekē i ēnei Tikanga mō ngā take whaimana: ngā huringa i roto i te ture, ngā āhuatanga hou, ngā whakaritenga haumarutanga, ngā huringa rānei i ngā ratonga tuatoru kua whakaurua.

14.2. Ka whakamōhiotia ngā Kaiwhakamahi mō ngā whakarerekētanga nui i te iti rawa 14 rā i mua i te whai mana, mā te īmēra, i roto rānei i te tono. Ki te kore te Kaiwhakamahi e whakaae, ka taea e ia te whakamutu i te ohaurunga i mua i te whai mana o ngā whakarerekētanga; ko te whakamahi tonu i muri i taua rā ka tohu i te whakaaetanga.

sections.b:

(I whakamutua te tūāpapa whakatau tautohetohe ā-ipurangi a te EU i te Hūrae 2025.)

cookies.metaDescription: He aha ngā pihikete me ngā urunga Local Storage e whakamahia ana e TrendTraffic, mō ngā kaupapa aha, ā, mō te roa o te wā, ko wai ngā rōpū tuatoru e whakatakoto pihikete (Stripe, Google sign-in), me pēhea te tuku, te whakakore, te whakarereke rānei i tō whakaae.

sections.h: 1. He aha ngā Pihikete me ngā Hangarau Rite
sections.b:
1.1. He kōnae kuputuhi iti ngā pihikete e rongoa ana ki tō pūrere ina toro koe ki tētahi paetukutuku, e āhei ai te pae ki te mōhio ki tō pūrere me te mahara ki ngā manakohanga.

1.2. I tua atu i ngā pihikete, ka whakamahi te tūāpapa TrendTraffic i te Local Storage o te pūtirotiro — i roto i ētahi atu mea, ki te rongoa i te tohu whakamana o tō wāhanga, tō reo me tō kaupapa atanga, me tō kōwhiringa whakaae pihikete. Ka hāngai tēnei Kaupapahere ki ngā pihikete me te Local Storage hoki.

sections.h: 2. Ngā Hangarau e Whakamahia ana e Mātou
sections.b:
2.1. He mea tino tika (hangarau) — e hiahiatia ana kia mahi te Tūāpapa; ka whakamahia i runga i te pānga tika o te Kaiwhakarato, ā, kāore e hiahiatia he whakaae:

  • vibevox_token — te tohu whakamana JWT o tō wāhanga (Local Storage; tae noa ki te puta, ki te pau rānei te tohu);
  • vibevox_user — he keteroki o te kōtaha o te kaiwhakamahi kua takiuru (Local Storage; tae noa ki te puta);
  • tt_cookie_consent — e rongoa ana i tō kōwhiringa whakaae pihikete (Local Storage; tae noa ki te whakarereke, ki te whakawātea rānei e koe).

2.2. Mahi (manakohanga):

  • i18nextLng — te reo atanga kua tohua (Local Storage; tae noa ki te whakarereke, ki te whakawātea rānei);
  • vibevox_theme — kaupapa mārama/pōuri (Local Storage; tae noa ki te whakarereke, ki te whakawātea rānei).

Mō ngā take o mua, kei ētahi tohu te kūmuri "vibevox" o te rārangi hua o mua o te Kaiwhakarato; nō te tūāpapa TrendTraffic ēnei.

2.3. Tātari: kāore te Tūāpapa e whakatakoto i ngā kaiwhai tātari, pānuitanga rōpū tuatoru rānei i tēnei wā. Ka kohia ngā inenga ratonga taketake, tiaki tūmataitinga i te taha tūmau me te kore e whaiwhai i ngā pae-whakawhiti. Mēnā ka whakaurua he tātari i runga i te whakaae, ka rere noa i muri i tō kōwhiringa "Whakaae katoa".

2.4. Pihikete rōpū tuatoru: ka taea e ngā ratonga o waho kua whakaurua ki roto i te Tūāpapa te whakatakoto i ō rātou ake pihikete ina whakamahi koe i aua mea:

  • Stripe — haumarutanga utu me te aukati tinihanga i ngā whārangi utu me ngā whārangi nama (hei tauira, __stripe_mid, ~1 tau; __stripe_sid, ~30 meneti);
  • Google — ina whakamahi koe i te "Takiuru me Google", ka whakatakoto a Google i ngā pihikete i raro i tana ake kaupapahere;
  • Ngā whatunga pāpori hono (TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube) — i roto noa i ō rātou ake atanga ina hono, ina whakatuwhera rānei koe i aua mea.

sections.h: 3. Ngā Kaupapa Whakamahi
sections.b:
• Te whakamana me te tiaki i te wāhanga o te Kaiwhakamahi.
  • Te haumarutanga o ngā tauwhitinga utu.
  • Te mahara ki te reo, te kaupapa me tō kōwhiringa whakaae.
  • Te whakarite i te pūmautanga me te mahi o te ratonga.

sections.h: 4. Whakaae me te Whakahaere Manakohanga
sections.b:
4.1. I tō toronga tuatahi, ka whakaatu te Tūāpapa i tētahi pānui whakaae i runga i te Upoko 399 o te Ture Whakawhitiwhiti Hiko o Poroni (Prawo komunikacji elektronicznej), te GDPR me te ePrivacy Directive (2002/58/EC). Ka taea e koe te kōwhiri "Whakaae katoa", "Mea tika anake" rānei — he rite te wātea o ngā kōwhiringa e rua, ā, kāore he hangarau kore-nui e whakahohehia i mua i tō kōwhiringa.

4.2. Ka taea e koe te whakarereke i tō kōwhiringa i ngā wā katoa — whakamahia te hononga "Tautuhinga pihikete" kei te hiku o te pae, te pātene rānei kei raro i tēnei Kaupapahere; ka tuwhera anō te pānui.

4.3. Ka taea hoki e te nuinga o ngā pūtirotiro te aukati, te muku rānei i ngā pihikete me te Local Storage i roto i ō rātou tautuhinga (Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Safari, Microsoft Edge). Kia mahara: mēnā ka aukatihia, ka mukua katoatia rānei ngā urunga tino tika, ka kore e taea te takiuru me te whakamahi i te Tūāpapa.

sections.h: 5. Ngā Wā Pupuri
sections.b:
• Ngā raraunga wāhanga: ka mukua i te puta, i te paunga rānei o te tohu whakamana.
  • Ngā manakohanga (reo, kaupapa, kōwhiringa whakaae): ka rongoa kia whakarereke koe, kia whakawātea rānei i ō raraunga pūtirotiro; ka whakahouhia te kōwhiringa whakaae i te iti rawa ia 12 marama mā te whakaatu anō i te pānui ina hiahiatia.
  • Ngā pihikete rōpū tuatoru: i runga i te kaupapahere a te kaiwhakarato e hāngai ana (tirohia te Wāhanga 2.4).
